hints.title: Sort by start
hints.body: After sorting, any overlap must involve adjacent meetings in the sorted order.

hints.title: Compare neighbors
hints.body: A conflict exists when the next start is earlier than the previous end.

hints.title: Touching is allowed
hints.body: Use a strict comparison so `end == start` is not a conflict.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
sort intervals by start
for i from 1 to n-1:
    if intervals[i].start < intervals[i-1].end:
        return false
return true
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
